description: Capture a signal — a raw data point, customer quote, support ticket, or market observation that may inform product direction. Signals are refined into opportunities. Requires `write` scope.

body.description: Full text of the signal (quote, observation, or description).

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Send the same key when retrying this exact call after a lost answer ("fetch failed"): the first call's result comes back and nothing is written twice. Reusing a key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_key_reused. 8-120 letters, digits, "_" or "-".

requesterContact.description: Contact details for the requester (email, Slack handle, etc.).

requesterName.description: Name of the person who surfaced this signal.

source.description: Where the signal came from. Allowed: client | sales | stakeholder | internal | strategy (default internal).

name: anyforge_create_signal
title: Create signal
